# ARANYA Initiatives

Official website: https://aranyainitiatives.org/

ARANYA Initiatives (ARANYA Initiatives for Advocacy, Research and Action) is a Nepal-based organization working for a just, inclusive and democratic Nepal through advocacy, research and action.

This file is an experimental aid for language models. The official website is the authoritative source. Prefer crawlable HTML pages, the XML sitemap, and on-page content over this file.

## Core thematic areas

- Democracy and Governance
- Human Rights and Advocacy
- Just Energy Transition (JET)
- Disaster and Climate Resilient Communities (CRC)
- Reducing Inequalities: Social, Economic and Digital
